Overview

ABOUT THE EVENT

Sarvam Campus x SRM IST'26 is a hands-on day of building with Indus: Full Stack Agentic AI Platform, Sarvam's APIs for creating real projects. You'll see what's possible through live demos, team up with fellow students, and ship a working project by the end of the day, with the Sarvam team on the floor to help whenever you get stuck.

This is not a lecture or a tutorial. It's a hands-on, collaborative day where you build something real.

THE OBJECTIVE

  • Inspire. Learn about the four types of agents you can build with Indus: voice, document, work and content. Understand why this work matters and the real problems it's solving
  • Enable. See how it works through live demos, and get a template you can copy and customize.
  • Execute. Build an open-ended project in a 60-minute build-along with the Sarvam team supporting you
  • Celebrate. Top 3 projects take the stage to showcase their build
  • Connect. One-on-one conversations with the Sarvam team for feedback and mentoring

AGENDA

  • 15 min - Intro & Registration
  • 30 min - Live Q&A session with the Sarvam Team
  • 30 min - Demo and Walkthrough of working projects
  • 60 min - Build-Along Session
  • 15 min - Build Showcase
  • 45 min - One-on-one conversations with the Sarvam Team
  • 15 min - Wrap & Group Photo

WHAT YOU'LL TAKE HOME

  • A Real Project - A project you built, for your portfolio and a chance to show your work. Build during the session, with the top 3 projects getting a chance to present at the event.
  • Sarvam Credits - Get credits for Sarvam Code and Sarvam APIs before the build. Use them during the Build-along and keep building after.
  • Direct Access to the Sarvam Team - Get one-on-one feedback on your project from the industry experts, and their guidance on what to build next.
  • Become a Sarvam Captain - Represent Sarvam on campus, lead initiatives that empower students, get exclusive resources and access to the Sarvam team to upskill, and connect with fellow captains across India.
  • Sarvam Merch - Everyone who takes part in the Build-along gets Sarvam merch.

NOT FROM SRM IST?

Check when Sarvam is coming to your campus at: https://www.sarvam.ai/sarvam-campus#campuses

Eligibility

  • Open exclusively to students at SRM IST.
  • Participants can register and participate individually.
  • No prior coding experience is required to participate.
  • All participants must complete their registration before the registration deadline.
  • Participants must follow the program rules and event guidelines.

Rules

1. Eligibility

  • The Sarvam Campus x SRMIST is open exclusively to SRMIST students.
  • All participants must complete their registration before the registration deadline.
  • Participants should register as individual participants.

2. Build-along Session

  • Participants can build their own solution during the Build-along Session.
  • Solutions should be built using Sarvam APIs and the tools introduced during the event.
  • No prior coding experience is required to participate in the Build-along.

4. Showcase

  • Participants may showcase what they build during the Build Showcase.
  • The top 3 builds will have an opportunity to present to the campus by the end of the day.

5. Code of Conduct

  • Treat all participants, mentors, organizers, and the Sarvam team with respect and professionalism.
  • Maintain a collaborative and inclusive environment throughout the event.

6. General

  • Participants must follow the instructions provided by the organizers and Sarvam team throughout the event.
  • The organizers reserve the right to make changes to the event schedule or guidelines if necessary.
